summary: Source review of the private payment and court-rent ledger: owner isolation, immutable entries, type and amount validation, and deterministic full-refund IDs are enforced. Firebase compilation passed. Browser tests use a Firebase stub; real SDK security-rule execution was not tested in an emulator. Existing public queue rules are outside this review.

findings.issue: Transaction and security-rule behavior has compilation and source review coverage, but no emulator execution coverage.
findings.recommendation: Add authenticated emulator tests for legitimate creates and refunds, unauthorized access, schema changes, timestamp manipulation, and repeated refunds before a broader rollout.

findings.issue: An authenticated owner can submit player payment entries outside the UI without acquiring the daily payment lock. The lock coordinates legitimate app clients rather than policing trusted cashiers.
findings.recommendation: If owners must also be prevented from bypassing daily payment limits, enforce the receipt-and-lock relationship in security rules or a trusted backend.
